faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.certificates_question: Can I get certificates for completed courses?
faq.certificates_answer: Yes, you will receive certificates upon completing courses successfully.
faq.free_resources_answer: Yes, we provide free educational resources for all students.
faq.graduation_projects_question: Can you help with graduation projects?
faq.graduation_projects_answer: Yes, we offer support and guidance for graduation projects.
faq.technical_support_question: How can I get technical support?
faq.technical_support_answer: You can contact our support team through the contact page.
faq.share_research_question: Can I share my research on the platform?
faq.share_research_answer: Yes, you can share your research and educational content.
faq.not_found_answer: Didn't find what you're looking for? Contact us.

naqraa_features.title: Educational communities in one place
naqraa_features.description: Connect, share, and learn within specialized academic communities.
details: Join groups related to your university or field of study.
Benefit from organized discussions and scheduled conversations.

naqraa_features.title: Chat and share ideas easily
naqraa_features.description: A full messaging system supporting individual and group communication in a safe educational environment.
details: Instant messaging between students and teachers.
Create discussion rooms for projects and research.
Support for all file types (PDF, Docs, Media).

naqraa_features.title: Smart management for educational institutions
naqraa_features.description: A centralized tool to manage students, instructors, and learning content efficiently.
details: Organize curriculum and learning resources in a digital library.
Generate full performance analytics and reports.

naqraa_features.title: Learn for free and share knowledge
naqraa_features.description: Hundreds of free courses and educational materials at your fingertips.
details: Unlimited access to courses across many fields.
A large library of open-source references and files.
Publish and share your own educational content.

naqraa_features.title: Create research and projects professionally
naqraa_features.description: A collaboration tool built for academic writing and scientific research.
details: A writing engine with math and academic formula support.
